artworks.title: Das leere Café (The Empty Café)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with crayons on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains swirling and intersecting lines, creating an abstract scene on the paper. The curved shapes and meandering lines hint at the contour of a room with tables and chairs. Angular lines and round shapes suggest the presence of objects or people like hats or lamps. The use of vibrant colors like red, yellow, and blue adds energy to the composition.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with Country Folk from Appenzell
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash on laid paper, squared for transfer and mounted on an old album sheet
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 29.5 x 41.5 cm (11 5/8 x 16 5/16 in.)
overall (album sheet): 40.9 x 53.7 cm (16 1/8 x 21 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men gathered outdoors. Several men are seated while others stand around them. The central figure, seated on the left, is shown in profile, resting his chin in his hand, wearing simple, loose clothing with a hat, and holding a stick in his other hand. His features are drawn with narrow eyes and a prominent nose, with short hair showing beneath the hat. To his right, another seated man faces forward, leaning slightly with his elbows on knees, wearing similar attire with a head covering and holding a cane or stick. Standing around them, a few other men are shown in discussion, engaged with one another, each dressed in typical rural wear of the time, including simple shirts and pants, some wearing hats or caps. The background features a sparsely detailed landscape with a few trees, depicted in a sketch-like manner, giving an impression of a natural, open-air setting. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or other objects apart from the canes or sticks some figures hold.

artworks.title: A Windmill against a Cloudy Sky
artworks.medium: oil paint and black chalk over charcoal on tan paper

artworks.title: Meridies (Noon)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures, with the full upper bodies of the adult figures and the entire body of the child visible. The central figure is a bearded man with long hair tied back, seated on the ground with one leg extended. To his right is a nude child reaching towards the bearded man, while the child’s head is turned to the left. The child is seated on the lap of a third figure, a partially draped woman sitting on the ground and holding the child securely. The woman's hair is styled back, and she has a serene facial expression. In the background, there is a tree with large leaves and a goat peering from behind the figures. The sky is depicted with thick clouds, and the engraving has the word "MERIDIES" in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Vesper (Evening)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure holding a child next to large urns. The figure is sitting on a structure by a tree, holding a small child with goat-like features. Two large vases are present in the foreground. The figure is holding a musical instrument, possibly a horn. The background features a landscape with clouds and distant hills. The use of line work reflects a classical theme.

artworks.title: Nox (Night)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures lying on the ground. The figure in the foreground is leaning against the second figure's legs. The first person has a muscular build, with short, tousled hair. The second figure is partially reclined with their head propped and feet extended. Both figures' faces are obscured. The scene is set outdoors with rocky formations and foliage in the background. Behind them is a large urn-like object emitting strong light or fire, illuminating the scene with contrasting light and shadow.

artworks.title: Aurora (Dawn)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure with goat-like legs and a human upper body holding a staff. Beside him is a female figure holding an infant. In the background to the left, there is a rooster with the word "Aurora" written. To the right are trees and a large amphora. The setting is outdoors in a natural landscape. The drawing style is detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude with Cat
artworks.medium: color woodcut on folded book prospectus
artworks.dimensions:
block: 6.2 x 9.4 cm (2 7/16 x 3 11/16 in.)
sheet (folded): 26.5 x 16.2 cm (10 7/16 x 6 3/8 in.)
sheet (unfolded): 26.5 x 32.4 cm (10 7/16 x 12 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a cover page with a combination of text and a graphic illustration. At the top, bold black text reads, "ERNST LUDWIG KIRCHNER DAS GRAPHISCHE WERK VON GUSTAV SCHIEFLER EUPHORION VERLAG / BERLIN." Below the text, there is a colorful illustration featuring a reclining nude figure with simplified contours in shades of orange and white against a background with bands of blue and violet. The image depicts the figure stretched out on what appears to be a bed, with one arm resting on the head. The remainder of the page includes a block of text in German, neatly aligned below the illustration. The background of the page is plain beige.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude with Cat (Illustration for _Ernst Ludwig Kirchner: Das Graphische Werk_)
artworks.medium: color woodcut illustration from two blocks, printed in orange and blue-violet on folded prospectus
artworks.dimensions:
block: 6.2 x 9.4 cm (2 7/16 x 3 11/16 in.)
sheet (folded): 26.5 x 16.2 cm (10 7/16 x 6 3/8 in.)
sheet (unfolded): 26.5 x 32.4 cm (10 7/16 x 12 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a book cover for "Das Graphische Werk" by Ernst Ludwig Kirchner. The image features bold text at the top, with the title and the publisher's name "Euphorion Verlag / Berlin," denoting the work of artist Ernst Ludwig Kirchner as compiled by Gustav Schiefler. Below the text, there is a woodcut image rendered in vibrant orange, blue, and beige hues, depicting a reclining nude figure with angular, expressionistic brush strokes, and a striped pattern in the background. The lower portion contains descriptive text in German related to the content of the book.

artworks.title: A Sunlit Landscape with Hilltop Houses
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with gray and gray-brown washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape from an elevated viewpoint. Trees partially obscure misty hills in the distance. In the foreground, there is a dirt path winding up a hill with grazing farm animals. A rustic building and resting livestock are visible, with two figures on a path leading to a prominent structure. The color palette is primarily gray, with delicate brushstrokes creating detailed depictions of architecture and natural elements. The sky has soft clouds.

artworks.title: Lusatian Landscape with the Landeskrone Mountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape seen from above. The horizon is high, displaying hills, trees, and a clear sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting foliage and clouds. The color scheme is primarily brown, creating a vintage look. In the foreground, there is an open field with a woman near a path, surrounded by trees. In the background are thatched-roof houses partially hidden by trees, hinting at a serene village life in the distance.

artworks.title: A River Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift in Memory of Melvin R. Seiden
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape scene created using a stippling technique. The horizon is positioned at the center, featuring distant spires and rooftops of a village. Rolling hills, shrubs, and a body of water are depicted in varying densities of dots. The sky is filled with scattered dots resembling clouds. The composition is rendered in monochrome black ink on a white background.

artworks.title: Les Fêtes de Rennes.  La grande Cavalcade Romaine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gladiator battle scene in an ancient Roman environment. The composition presents a depiction of a gladiatorial combat in an open arena surrounded by ancient architectural structures. In the foreground, figures are wearing gladiator attire, including helmets and armed with shields and weapons. The scene shows various gladiators with dynamic poses suggesting movement. One figure stands prominently at the front with a shield adorned with decorative imagery. In the background, more spectators can be seen observing the event. The drawing captures a moment filled with tension and historical atmosphere, rendered in intricate lines and shading, evoking the intensity of ancient Roman gladiatorial contests.

artworks.title: Le Cabaret du Coq de Bruyère au Bois de Meudon
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor café scene. The setting is a garden or outdoor café under large trees, with people engaging in various leisurely activities. Several tables are occupied with individuals enjoying drinks and conversation. One table in the foreground features a hat and a drink. In the mid-ground, a person is swinging on a swing attached to a tree branch. A waiter is serving patrons, contributing to the lively atmosphere. The trees overhead create a play of light and shadow. The painting is reminiscent of the style of Pierre-Auguste Renoir.

artworks.title: Baptême royal à la Cour d'Espagne
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a ceremony taking place in a grand hall. The scene features clergy, dignitaries, and an audience. In the center, figures in ornate clothing are performing a ritual on an elevated platform. The hall is decorated elaborately with tall pillars and detailed arches. Light streams in from above, highlighting the central platform. The attendees are dressed elegantly.

artworks.title: Manifestation populaire du 27 Février pour fêter le 80 année de Victor Hugo
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a large crowd in front of a grand building. The scene shows a multitude of individuals in attire from the late 19th to early 20th century. They are gathered around a statue or focal point outside the building. Tall trees frame the scene, with bare branches suggesting late autumn or winter. There are banners and possibly a marching band or procession, indicating festivities or a significant public event. The details capture the essence of the era, from the decor to the crowd's clothing.

artworks.title: Funérailles de Victor Hugo.  La Veillée
artworks.artist: Auguste Lepère after Henri Louis Scott
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural arch with a gathering and decorations. The scene captures a large arch structure with elaborate banners and flags. Multiple figures are present in front of the arch, some carrying torches or lights. The scene conveys a dramatic atmosphere through the use of shadow and light. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of historical or classical illustrations, emphasizing grandeur and fine detail.

artworks.title: Fêtes jubilaires de Bruxelles
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand parade or procession near an archway. The scene depicts a detailed and lively procession with a prominent triumphal arch in the background, adorned with statues and intricate carvings. To the left, a statue stands atop a pedestal, surrounded by banners and figures, some with raised arms. Horse-drawn carriages, robed figures, and spectators fill the busy street. The architectural elements suggest a celebratory or commemorative atmosphere, with a richly detailed illustration capturing the vibrancy of the event.

artworks.title: Le Couronnement de l'Empereur Alexandre III de Russie (27 Mai)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals in a ceremonial setting. A central figure stands on a raised platform, partaking in a coronation event. They are receiving a crown from another person. Surrounding them are others in military uniforms and rich robes. Some individuals hold scepters and wear jewelry. The environment is decorated with architectural elements, including columns, a canopy, and grand imagery. Chandelier lighting illuminates the space, with figures lining the steps and side areas.

artworks.title: L'Inconestase de la Cathedrale de l'Assomption
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate interior of a religious space. The image shows a richly decorated space, likely from a church or cathedral. The walls are adorned with framed religious icons featuring haloed figures and Biblical scenes. There are large doors in the center with religious imagery. The ceiling has elaborate chandeliers with candle-like extensions. The foreground includes ornamental railings and stands supporting tall candlesticks for ceremonies. The space is highly textured with patterns and carvings on nearly every surface, conveying a sense of grandeur and reverence.

artworks.title: Le Couronnement du Tzar.  Le Cortège imperiale traverse la Place Royale
artworks.description: This image shows a street level view of a grand parade scene. St. Basil's Cathedral with its onion domes is on the left, while the Spasskaya Tower of the Kremlin is on the right. In the center, there is a monument. The style of the image is intricate and detailed, resembling an engraving with fine lines for texture. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of sepia. Soldiers and horse-drawn carriages are seen on the wet street, with their reflections visible. In the background, historic structures and a busy skyline contribute to the historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Les Funérailles de L'Amiral Courbet
artworks.description: This image shows a ceremonial procession in a city square with ornate buildings. The drawing depicts a detailed scene with numerous figures dressed in ceremonial attire, arranged across a wide, cobblestone square. Around the procession are intricately designed buildings with architectural elements like steep roofs and tall windows. In the background, a towering cathedral or large church dominates the skyline with detailed stonework and a tall spire. The foreground includes elaborately adorned floats or vehicles. The atmosphere suggests grandeur and formality, captured through diligent line work and an emphasis on the cohesive activity within the public space.

artworks.title: Les Honneurs militaires rendus à la Depouille mortelle de L'Amiral Courbet
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird's-eye view of an event in an urban setting. Closest to us, there are figures on rooftops. The main road is lined with horse-drawn carriages and to the right is a large building. Beyond the road, there are people or military formations in open grounds. In the distance is a building with two spires against a cloudy sky. The style of the image includes cross-hatching and line work, creating a textured appearance in monochrome.

artworks.title: Les ruins du Palais des Tuilleries avant leur démolition
artworks.description: The image shows a busy outdoor scene in front of an ornate building. People are feeding birds, a statue stands on the right, and a fountain is in the center. The building's grand architectural design dominates the horizon. The sky has soft clouds. The color palette is mostly gray and brown, resembling traditional etching or engraving techniques.
